title: Iconography Intro
slide_intent: Judge an icon by whether someone can recognize its function at the small size where it will be used.
strategic_value: Instacart can give interface symbols a clear functional standard alongside its more expressive illustration system.
demonstration: A large statement about functionality and small-size legibility appears on a pale field. The page uses only text to introduce the criterion.
practical_value: Before approving an icon, inspect it at its intended display size and ask whether the feature it represents remains identifiable.

content_islands.name: Section label
content_islands.spec: Place Iconography Intro at upper left beneath the running identifiers.

content_islands.name: Functional principle
content_islands.spec: Set the statement in large dark green type across three lines, leaving ample space below.
